patterns.title: Missing import or symbol
patterns.summary: The generated test references a class, method, or package that is not resolvable from project sources or classpath.
patterns.llmHeuristic: Search before editing imports. Do not invent packages or class names. If the same missing symbol repeats after REQUEST_CONTEXT and the project context already names that class or collaborator, patch the import or type reference directly with the smallest correction.

patterns.title: Deprecated Mockito zero-interaction helper
patterns.summary: The generated test uses an outdated Mockito helper such as verifyZeroInteractions that is unavailable in the active classpath and should be replaced with the supported zero-interaction verification API.
patterns.llmHeuristic: Replace verifyZeroInteractions(...) with verifyNoInteractions(...) on the same mocks and keep the surrounding assertions intact.

patterns.title: Wrong package for a real project symbol
patterns.summary: The generated test imports a real project type from the wrong package even though the simple symbol exists in project sources under a different package.
patterns.llmHeuristic: If SEARCH_SYMBOL resolves exactly one importable candidate for the missing simple name, replace or remove the wrong import immediately instead of requesting the same context again.

patterns.title: Method signature mismatch
patterns.summary: The generated test is calling a real API with the wrong parameter count, wrong overload, or wrong static/instance shape.
patterns.llmHeuristic: Read the actual API first, then patch only the invocation or assertion that violates the signature.

patterns.title: Type mismatch
patterns.summary: The test compiles against a wrong inferred type, usually caused by invented return assumptions or wrong matcher type.
patterns.llmHeuristic: Align the test with the real return and parameter types. Do not rewrite unrelated setup.

patterns.title: Access violation
patterns.summary: The generated test is trying to touch private or package-inaccessible members.
patterns.llmHeuristic: Replace private-member interaction with public setup or observable verification. Never bypass visibility with reflection.

patterns.title: Syntax error
patterns.summary: The generated Java source is malformed and must be repaired structurally before deeper reasoning.
patterns.llmHeuristic: Fix syntax with the smallest source edit. Preserve the surrounding test intent.

patterns.title: Duplicate JUnit annotation after merge
patterns.summary: The generated test contains repeated JUnit lifecycle or @Test annotations, usually after merge noise duplicated an annotation line.
patterns.llmHeuristic: Collapse duplicate consecutive JUnit annotations introduced by test merge noise. Prefer a bounded recipe over free-form patching when one is supplied.

patterns.title: Invented User state constructor
patterns.summary: The generated test encoded later User state through an unavailable constructor overload or a no-arg constructor that does not exist.
patterns.llmHeuristic: When User state was packed into an unavailable constructor or a no-arg constructor path, prefer the bounded recipe that rewrites the fixture to User(String, String) plus legal public mutators.
